main_dirt.bias_notes: Known as 'Big Sandy' — the largest dirt racing strip in North America with sweeping 1.5-mile turns. The deep, sandy loam surface penalizes one-dimensional speed horses in route races. Wide, sweeping closers ('Swoopers') have ample stretch length to run down leaders on fast dirt.
main_dirt.post_bias: Extremely fair due to the massive 1.5-mile circumference. Wide post positions are easily managed around the massive turns.

widener_turf.bias_notes: Outer turf course with wide, sweeping turns. Extremely fair to all running styles.

inner_turf.bias_notes: Inner turf course featuring tighter turns than the Widener course. Slightly elevates tactical speed ('P').
inner_turf.post_bias: Inside barriers hold a minor advantage.

handicapping_angles.big_sandy_stamina_test: The 1.5-mile main track requires genuine stamina. In dirt routes (1M to 1 1/2M), penalize early speed ('E') types lacking proven 2nd-call stamina.
handicapping_angles.chad_brown_and_todd_pletcher_dominance: Elite NYRA stables (Chad Brown, Todd Pletcher, Christophe Clement, Linda Rice) dominate NYRA Belmont meetings.
handicapping_angles.belmont_stakes_class_par: Belmont Stakes (12F) and Grade 1 Belmont festival races carry top Tier 1 class offsets (+5.0 speed par).
